units.rightText: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.

units.leftText: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement. He will put on the sacred linen garments
units.rightText: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments:

units.leftText: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the assembly.
units.rightText: and he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
leftNotes: 16:33 Or the Holy Sanctuary

units.leftText: This is to be a permanent statute for you, to make atonement once a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.” And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the Israelites and tell them this is what the LORD has commanded:
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp or outside of it
units.rightText: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
leftNotes: 17:3 Or a bull or a cow

units.leftText: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle— that man shall incur bloodguilt. He has shed blood and must be cut off from among his people.
units.rightText: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

units.leftText: For this reason the Israelites will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they have been offering in the open fields. They are to bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and offer them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
units.rightText: to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: The priest will then splatter the blood on the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves. This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come.’
units.rightText: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute forever unto them throughout their generations.
leftNotes: 17:7 Or goat idols

units.leftText: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice
units.rightText: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,

units.leftText: but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man must be cut off from his people. Laws against Eating Blood
units.rightText: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
units.rightText: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

units.leftText: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for your souls upon the altar; for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.
units.rightText: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.
leftNotes: 17:11 Literally the soul; also in verse 14

units.leftText: Therefore I say to the Israelites, ‘None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner living among you eat blood.’
units.rightText: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

units.leftText: And if any Israelite or foreigner living among them hunts down a wild animal or bird that may be eaten, he must drain its blood and cover it with dirt.
units.rightText: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

units.leftText: For the life of all flesh is its blood. Therefore I have told the Israelites, ‘You must not eat the blood of any living thing, because the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it must be cut off.’
units.rightText: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is all one with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

units.leftText: And any person, whether native or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening; then he will be clean.
units.rightText: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

units.leftText: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, then he shall bear his iniquity.”
units.rightText: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
units.rightText: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.

units.leftText: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Keep My statutes and My judgments, for the man who does these things will live by them. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 18:5 Cited in Romans 10:5|ROM 10:5* and Galatians 3:12; see also Ezekiel 20:11, 13, and 21.

units.leftText: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 18:6 Literally to uncover (their) nakedness; here and throughout this chapter

units.leftText: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover; it is thy father’s nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for that would shame your family.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.

units.leftText: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her; she is your aunt.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you are not to have sexual relations with her.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would shame your brother.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

units.leftText: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival to her, to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.

units.leftText: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her during her menstrual period.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

units.leftText: You must not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

units.leftText: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through the fire to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 18:21 Hebrew to make them pass through (the fire)

units.leftText: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

units.leftText: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

units.leftText: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves.
units.rightText: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;

units.leftText: Even the land has become defiled, so I am punishing it for its sin, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.
units.rightText: and the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.

units.leftText: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances, and you must not commit any of these abominations— neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you.
units.rightText: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you

units.leftText: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations, and the land has become defiled.
units.rightText: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);

units.leftText: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.
units.rightText: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

units.leftText: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.
units.rightText: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

units.leftText: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”
units.rightText: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
units.rightText: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.
leftNotes: 19:2 Cited in 1 Peter 1:16|1PE 1:16*

units.leftText: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
units.rightText: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.

units.leftText: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
units.rightText: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.

units.leftText: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
units.rightText: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:

units.leftText: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people. Love Your Neighbor (Romans 13:8–10|ROM 13:8-10*)
units.rightText: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
units.rightText: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.

units.leftText: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.
units.rightText: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.

units.leftText: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

units.leftText: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.

units.leftText: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 19:16 Literally blood

units.leftText: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

units.leftText: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD. Keep My Statutes
units.rightText: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 19:18 Cited in Matthew 5:43|MAT 5:43*, Matthew 19:19, Matthew 22:39, Mark 12:31, Luke 10:27, Romans 13:9, Galatians 5:14, and James 2:8

units.leftText: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
units.rightText: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.

units.leftText: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
units.rightText: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

units.leftText: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.

units.leftText: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
units.rightText: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.

units.leftText: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
units.rightText: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.
leftNotes: 19:23 Hebrew as uncircumcised; twice in this verse

units.leftText: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
units.rightText: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.

units.leftText: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
units.rightText: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

units.leftText: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
units.rightText: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

units.leftText: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
units.rightText: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.

units.leftText: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

units.leftText: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
leftNotes: 19:36 An ephah is a dry measure of approximately 20 dry quarts or 22 liters.
19:36 A hin is a liquid measure of approximately 0.97 gallons or 3.67 liters.

units.leftText: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
units.rightText: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

units.leftText: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
units.rightText: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

units.leftText: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
units.rightText: And if the people of the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;

units.leftText: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
units.rightText: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.

units.leftText: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
units.rightText: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

units.leftText: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
units.rightText: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.

units.leftText: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him. Punishments for Sexual Immorality (Proverbs 5:1–23|PRO 5:1-23*; 1 Corinthians 5:1–8|1CO 5:1-8*)
units.rightText: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
leftNotes: 20:9 Or dishonors or reviles; similarly again in this verse
20:9 Cited in Matthew 15:4|MAT 15:4* and Mark 7:10

units.leftText: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife— with the wife of his neighbor— both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
units.rightText: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
units.rightText: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

units.leftText: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

units.leftText: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
units.rightText: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
units.rightText: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
leftNotes: 20:17 Literally and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness

units.leftText: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
units.rightText: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
leftNotes: 20:18 Literally uncovers her nakedness; similarly in verse 19

units.leftText: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

units.leftText: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
units.rightText: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

units.leftText: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless. Distinguish between Clean and Unclean
units.rightText: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

units.leftText: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.

units.leftText: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
units.rightText: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

units.leftText: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance — a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
units.rightText: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.

units.leftText: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.

units.leftText: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
units.rightText: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.

units.leftText: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
units.rightText: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;

units.leftText: except for his immediate family — his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,
units.rightText: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

units.leftText: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.
units.rightText: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.

units.leftText: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.
units.rightText: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

units.leftText: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
units.rightText: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

units.leftText: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the food offerings, the food of their God, they must be holy.
units.rightText: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

units.leftText: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
units.rightText: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

units.leftText: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy — I who set you apart.
units.rightText: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee; for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.

units.leftText: If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.
units.rightText: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

units.leftText: The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.
units.rightText: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;
leftNotes: 21:10 Or must not uncover his head

units.leftText: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.
units.rightText: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

units.leftText: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The woman he marries must be a virgin.
units.rightText: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

units.leftText: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,
units.rightText: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.

units.leftText: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.” Restrictions against Those with Blemishes
units.rightText: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

units.leftText: No man who has any defect may approach — no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;
units.rightText: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,

units.leftText: no man who has a broken foot or hand,
units.rightText: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,

units.leftText: or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.
units.rightText: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

units.leftText: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the food offerings to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.
units.rightText: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

units.leftText: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food,
units.rightText: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:

units.leftText: but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
units.rightText: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
units.rightText: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Tell them that for the generations to come, if any of their descendants in a state of uncleanness approaches the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from My presence. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: If a descendant of Aaron has a skin disease or a discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is clean. Whoever touches anything defiled by a corpse or by a man who has an emission of semen,
units.rightText: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
leftNotes: 22:4 Forms of the Hebrew tzaraath, traditionally translated as leprosy, were used for various skin diseases; see Leviticus 13.

units.leftText: or whoever touches a crawling creature or a person that makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be —
units.rightText: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

units.leftText: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening. He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.
units.rightText: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.

units.leftText: When the sun has set, he will become clean, and then he may eat from the sacred offerings, for they are his food.
units.rightText: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

units.leftText: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, which would make him unclean. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The priests must keep My charge, lest they bear the guilt and die because they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
units.rightText: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it.
units.rightText: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest’s, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

units.leftText: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.
units.rightText: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

units.leftText: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.
units.rightText: And if a priest’s daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.

units.leftText: But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house, she may share her father’s food as in her youth. But no outsider may share it.
units.rightText: But if a priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

units.leftText: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error, he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest.
units.rightText: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.

units.leftText: The priests must not profane the sacred offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD
units.rightText: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,

units.leftText: by allowing the people to eat the sacred offerings and thus to bear the punishment for guilt. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.” Worthy Offerings
units.rightText: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and tell them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;

units.leftText: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle, sheep, or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf.
units.rightText: that ye may be accepted, ye shall offer a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.

units.leftText: You must not present anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.
units.rightText: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

units.leftText: When a man presents a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without blemish or defect to be acceptable.
units.rightText: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

units.leftText: You are not to present to the LORD any animal that is blind, injured, or maimed, or anything with a running sore, a festering rash, or a scab; you must not put any of these on the altar as a food offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.
units.rightText: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
leftNotes: 22:23 Or a bull or a cow

units.leftText: You are not to present to the LORD an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn, or cut; you are not to sacrifice them in your land.
units.rightText: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do thus in your land.

units.leftText: Neither you nor a foreigner shall present food to your God from any such animal. They will not be accepted on your behalf, because they are deformed and flawed.’”
units.rightText: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “When an ox, a sheep, or a goat is born, it must remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as a food offering presented to the LORD.
units.rightText: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
leftNotes: 22:27 Or a calf

units.leftText: But you must not slaughter an ox or a sheep on the same day as its young.
units.rightText: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
leftNotes: 22:28 Or a cow

units.leftText: When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD, offer it so that it may be acceptable on your behalf.
units.rightText: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.

units.leftText: It must be eaten that same day. Do not leave any of it until morning. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You are to keep My commandments and practice them. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You must not profane My holy name. I must be acknowledged as holy among the Israelites. I am the LORD who sanctifies you,
units.rightText: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,

units.leftText: who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘These are My appointed feasts, the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

units.leftText: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28|EXO 12:14-28*; Numbers 28:16–25|NUM 28:16-25*; Deuteronomy 16:1–8|DEU 16:1-8*)
units.rightText: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times.
units.rightText: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.

units.leftText: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.
units.rightText: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah’s passover.
leftNotes: 23:5 Hebrew begins between the two evenings of the fourteenth

units.leftText: On the fifteenth day of the same month begins the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD. For seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
units.rightText: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.
leftNotes: 23:6 That is, the seven-day period after the Passover during which no leaven may be eaten; see Exodus 12:14–20|EXO 12:14-20*.

units.leftText: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly; you are not to do any regular work.
units.rightText: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD. On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.’” The Feast of Firstfruits
units.rightText: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:

units.leftText: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.
units.rightText: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

units.leftText: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a year-old lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD,
units.rightText: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil — a food offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma — and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
units.rightText: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
leftNotes: 23:13 Two-tenths of an ephah is approximately 4 dry quarts or 4.4 liters (probably about 5.1 pounds or 2.3 kilograms of flour); also in verse 17.
23:13 A quarter hin is approximately 0.97 quarts or 0.92 liters of wine.

units.leftText: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day you have brought this offering to your God. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live. The Feast of Weeks (Acts 2:1–13|ACT 2:1-13*)
units.rightText: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.
units.rightText: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:

units.leftText: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.
units.rightText: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts of an ephah: they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings — a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall also prepare one male goat as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old as a peace offering.
units.rightText: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.

units.leftText: The priest is to wave the lambs as a wave offering before the LORD, together with the bread of the firstfruits. The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
units.rightText: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.

units.leftText: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come.
units.rightText: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

units.leftText: When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident. I am the LORD your God.’” The Feast of Trumpets (Numbers 29:1–6|NUM 29:1-6*)
units.rightText: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: The LORD also said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly announced by trumpet blasts.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
leftNotes: 23:24 Or a sacred assembly, a memorial of shouting

units.leftText: You must not do any regular work, but you are to present a food offering to the LORD.’” The Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:1–34|LEV 16:1-34*; Numbers 29:7–11|NUM 29:7-11*)
units.rightText: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Again the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble yourselves, and present a food offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
leftNotes: 23:27 Or afflict your souls or deny yourselves; also in verse 32

units.leftText: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people.
units.rightText: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day; he shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.
units.rightText: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.

units.leftText: You are not to do any work at all. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall humble yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath.” The Feast of Tabernacles (Nehemiah 8:13–18|NEH 8:13-18*; Zechariah 14:16–21|ZEC 14:16-21*)
units.rightText: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.

units.leftText: And the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD begins, and it continues for seven days.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Jehovah.
leftNotes: 23:34 That is, Sukkot, the autumn feast of pilgrimage to Jerusalem; also translated as the Feast of Booths or the Feast of Shelters and originally called the Feast of Ingathering(see Exodus 23:16|EXO 23:16* and Exodus 34:22).

units.leftText: On the first day there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any regular work.
units.rightText: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD. On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
units.rightText: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for presenting food offerings to the LORD — burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings, each on its designated day.
units.rightText: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;

units.leftText: These offerings are in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s Sabbaths, and in addition to your gifts, to all your vow offerings, and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.
units.rightText: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the produce of the land, you are to celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days. There shall be complete rest on the first day and also on the eighth day.
units.rightText: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

units.leftText: On the first day you are to gather the fruit of majestic trees, the branches of palm trees, and the boughs of leafy trees and of willows of the brook. And you are to rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.
units.rightText: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.
leftNotes: 23:40 Or poplars

units.leftText: You are to celebrate this as a feast to the LORD for seven days each year. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come; you are to celebrate it in the seventh month.
units.rightText: And ye shall keep it a feast unto Jehovah seven days in the year: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.

units.leftText: You are to dwell in booths for seven days. All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths,
units.rightText: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
leftNotes: 23:42 Or tabernacles or shelters; twice in this verse, and also in verse 43; see the footnote for verse 34.

units.leftText: so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: So Moses announced to the Israelites the appointed feasts of the LORD.
units.rightText: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

units.leftText: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come.
units.rightText: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.
leftNotes: 24:3 The Testimony refers to the stone tablets in the ark of the covenant inscribed with the Ten Commandments.

units.leftText: He shall tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually. The Showbread (Exodus 25:23–30|EXO 25:23-30*; Exodus 37:10–16|EXO 37:10-16*)
units.rightText: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.

units.leftText: You are also to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf,
units.rightText: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
leftNotes: 24:5 Two-tenths of an ephah is approximately 4 dry quarts or 4.4 liters (probably about 5.1 pounds or 2.3 kilograms of flour).

units.leftText: and set them in two rows — six per row — on the table of pure gold before the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.

units.leftText: And you are to place pure frankincense near each row, so that it may serve as a memorial portion for the bread, a food offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Every Sabbath day the bread is to be set out before the LORD on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant.
units.rightText: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.

units.leftText: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place; for it is to him a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD — his portion forever.” Punishment for Blasphemy
units.rightText: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.

units.leftText: Now the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father went out among the Israelites, and a fight broke out in the camp between him and an Israelite.
units.rightText: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:

units.leftText: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse. So they brought him to Moses. (His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.)
units.rightText: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

units.leftText: They placed him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them.
units.rightText: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the blasphemer outside the camp, and have all who heard him lay their hands on his head; then have the whole assembly stone him.
units.rightText: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
leftNotes: 24:14 Literally the one who cursed; also in verse 23

units.leftText: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘If anyone curses his God, he shall bear the consequences of his sin.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

units.leftText: Whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death; the whole assembly must surely stone him, whether he is a foreign resident or native; if he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death. An Eye for an Eye (Matthew 5:38–48|MAT 5:38-48*)
units.rightText: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, shall be put to death.

units.leftText: And if a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.
units.rightText: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution — life for life.
units.rightText: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.

units.leftText: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:
units.rightText: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:

units.leftText: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. Just as he injured the other person, the same must be inflicted on him.
units.rightText: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.
leftNotes: 24:20 Cited in Matthew 5:38|MAT 5:38*

units.leftText: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
units.rightText: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.

units.leftText: You are to have the same standard of law for the foreign resident and the native; for I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land itself must observe a Sabbath to the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.
units.rightText: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;

units.leftText: But in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of complete rest for the land — a Sabbath to the LORD.
units.rightText: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

units.leftText: You are not to reap the aftergrowth of your harvest or gather the grapes of your untended vines. The land must have a year of complete rest.
units.rightText: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather: it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

units.leftText: Whatever the land yields during the Sabbath year shall be food for you— for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, the hired hand or foreigner who stays with you,
units.rightText: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.

units.leftText: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food. The Year of Jubilee
units.rightText: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.

units.leftText: And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years — seven times seven years — so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.
units.rightText: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.

units.leftText: Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou send abroad the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye send abroad the trumpet throughout all your land.

units.leftText: So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
units.rightText: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

units.leftText: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
units.rightText: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of the undressed vines.

units.leftText: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field. Return of Property
units.rightText: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

units.leftText: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.
units.rightText: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.

units.leftText: If you make a sale to your neighbor or a purchase from him, you must not take advantage of each other.
units.rightText: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbor, or buy of thy neighbor’s hand, ye shall not wrong one another.

units.leftText: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
units.rightText: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, and according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.

units.leftText: You shall increase the price in proportion to a greater number of years, or decrease it in proportion to a lesser number of years; for he is selling you a given number of harvests.
units.rightText: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of the crops doth he sell unto thee.

units.leftText: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God. The Blessing of Obedience (Deuteronomy 28:1–14|DEU 28:1-14*)
units.rightText: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.
